PUSH REJECTED: I built all three steps and committed them on local `develop`, but neither push went through. Others had pushed first, and per the brief I did not rebase. The supervisor needs to rebase and push the two commits. The gate was green.

- **de2af5b2** (steps 1 and 2):
  - `nikaia lower-std --bounds [--optimization NAME:LEVEL]...` checks each `tools/*.nika` with the rest of the package beside it, the same way `lower-std` does. It then prints the same report `check --bounds` prints, file by file. It writes nothing and reads no cache. The `runtime` package and the `std` modules are left out, and `--help` says so.
  - `scripts/proved.nika` sums a saved report into a totals line, the unproved sites by reason, and the 15 files with the most unproved sites.
- **8aed3f6** (step 3): today's figures and the commands in `docs/formal-verification.md` §2, §4 and §5.

Over the checkout, all 246 files were reported and none was refused:

| Walk | Indexes proved | Arithmetic steps proved |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| default | 1,503 of 2,608 (57.6 %) | 719 of 1,601 (44.9 %) |
| `prove-through-loops:on` | 1,535 (58.9 %) | 726 (45.3 %) |

Both totals are above the old per-file count (1,821 / 965 and 1,381 / 560). The site the brief named, `indexed.atoms[atom]` in `logic_search.nika`, is now listed (it is on line 64 today, not 63). Of the 1,987 sites still checked, 1,877 are values no fact bounds: a counter, a loop or a length. The unit tests of the two touched modules passed (8). A `tests/compiler` program can't run a sysroot command, so there is no new test program.

Two things to check:
- **`Fixes` changed to `Part of #1053`.** `commit.nika` wrote `Fixes #1053` into the second commit. Before any push I amended its message to `Part of #1053`, because the brief is only step 1 of #1053 and the p3 brief may belong to it too. Change it back if #1053 is really finished.
- **Version raise.** The change touches `crates/`, so by CLAUDE.md it raises the version. That is yours; the report's `Changelog:` line has the entry.

Disk: nothing freed; the test cache is 529M and 26G are free. This run added two cache entries of 265 MB each.
